title: File attachment
body:
I love using Google Keep for its speed and simplicity, but the inability to attach PDF files is a significant limitation.
Currently, I have to jump between Google Drive and Keep just to reference a document related to a note.

Why this would be helpful:
• Centralization: It would allow users to keep receipts, tickets, or short documents right next to their checklists and reminders.
• Efficiency: It removes the extra steps of copying/ pasting Drive links.
• Workspace Unity: it would make Keep a more powerful companion to Google Docs and Gmail.

Please consider adding a "File" attachment button alongside the existing "Image" and "Drawing" options.

Thank you.

title: Suggestion for the upcoming update
body: I’ve been using Google Keep since 2014, and it’s proven to be really useful to me. I can’t imagine using any other application than this one. Over the course of 6 years, I’ve been changing my devices constantly and it’s great that I can always access Google Keep from any of these devices. But I wish I was able to use different types of fonts—bold, italics, and underlined—to add distinctive effects within contents of my notes. One more thing that would be useful is to improve the word search feature. Rather than only showing which note the word is used in, the app should be able to direct the user to the exact line and paragraph the word is located in, within the notes.
